title: WhatsApp image request: a named menu-image page (Secret Creations) sends that page's photo, never the whole menu
notes: 'show secret creations' matches this business's own real, active business_menu_images page name (injected via the 'menu_pages' conv-JSON key, not hardcoded anywhere in the shared intent router). Proves a single specific page is sent -- not every page at once ('avoid unnecessary image messages') -- and the cart stays untouched.
